text:
amy: Quick heads-up — planning a soft rollforward for release r-2026.03.22. We need to flip the feature flag `llm_v2_route` in a staggered ramp: 0% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. ping @sre and @qa :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sanjay: ack. I'll own telemetry (p95 latency, 5xx, token cost). What's the pin for the canary model?

amy: Canary will be pinned to `model-llm-v2.3.1-quant` (read-only). Production fallback is `model-llm-v2.3.0`. We'll set routing pin before ramping.

oliver: Can you add rollback criteria explicitly? I want thresholds we can act on without debate.

amy: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- error rate (5xx+client errors) > 0.8% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for 10m
- token cost/req increase > 20% vs baseline for 15m
If any of these trigger, set flag to 0% and pin routing back to `model-llm-v2.3.0`.

jia: Add one more: quality regressions on eval set (LLM QA): if automated eval drop >4% absolute on the smoke prompts. QA will run evals at each step.

amy: good call. QA eval pass required to hit next step.

deploy-bot: INFO: queued flag change `llm_v2_route` for r-2026.03.22 by amy. Will execute ramp steps via scheduled events. Will post updates at each step.

sre-bot: NOTE: creating temporary alert policy cc: @sanjay. Alert on 5xx, p95, and cost delta. will auto-notify #eng-oncall.

amy: Operational plan:
1) 02:05 UTC — pin canary routing to `model-llm-v2.3.1-quant` on canary pool only
2) 02:15 UTC — flip flag to 50% (cohorted slice)
3) 02:25 UTC — evaluate telemetry + QA evals
4) 02:35 UTC — if good, flip to 100%
5) 02:45 UTC — verify and remove pin (if everything stable)

Command for ops to flip flag quickly if needed:
```
# toggle to 0% (emergency)
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.io/flags/llm_v2_route/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"percent":0}'
```

oliver: Will take watch at 02:15 -> 02:40 UTC. If I see >0.5% error spike I'll pause and call rollback.

sanjay: I'll copy alert links here when the monitors are ready. Also capturing baseline now (p95 115ms, 5xx 0.12%, token cost index 1.0).

deploy-bot: ACTION: scheduled step 1 at 02:05 UTC: apply pin `model-llm-v2.3.1-quant` to canary.

amy: small note — keep an eye on tail latency for long contexts (>=2048). That historically spikes with quant changes.

jia: QA will run smoke eval set at 02:20 and 02:30. Posting results into this thread.

deploy-bot: UPDATE 02:06 UTC: canary pin applied successfully to pool cg-3.

deploy-bot: UPDATE 02:16 UTC: ramped `llm_v2_route` to 50% (cohort slice). Notifying watchers.

jia: QA eval 02:22 UTC: small drift on one prompt set, drop 2.3% (within threshold). No blockers.

oliver: telemetry 02:24 UTC: p95 130ms (baseline 115), 5xx 0.18%, cost index 1.03. All within agreed limits — hold for next check.

amy: proceeding to 100% in 02:35 window unless anyone calls hold.

sanjay: alerts green. keeping watch.

deploy-bot: UPDATE 02:36 UTC: ramped `llm_v2_route` to 100%.

jia: QA eval 02:38 UTC: pass. No regressions >4%.

oliver: final check 02:43 UTC: p95 stable 128ms, 5xx 0.16%. Looks good.

amy: thanks all. I'll remove the canary pin at 02:50 and mark release notes: "r-2026.03.22: switched default routing to llm-v2.3.1-quant; gradual rollout; metrics monitored; rollback thresholds defined."

sre-bot: NOTE: temp alerts will expire in 3 hours unless extended.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: rollforward finished. If anyone needs to revert, use the curl snippet above or tag me with `@deploy-bot rollback llm_v2_route`.
